description:
The Rotary Club of Bombay Metropolitan, in partnership with the Ratna Nidhi Trust, successfully conducted a 1-day vision care camp at Marwari Vidayalaya High School in Charni Road 26th October 2026, screening 350 Students & provided 53 Spactacles.
Providing eye check-ups for 350 students is a significant achievement that will greatly help these children in their academic journey and daily lives.
